skill.name: entra-agent-id
skill.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities with Microsoft Graph. Configure OAuth 2.0 fmi_path, on-behalf-of flows, cross-tenant token exchange, and the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar.
skill.summary: Create Entra Agent ID identities, grants, token exchanges, and sidecar configurations for AI agents.
skill.author: microsoft

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection, concealed exfiltration, or obfuscated execution was found. Most static hits are markdown formatting, official Microsoft Graph or Entra endpoints, localhost sidecar calls, or OAuth scope strings. Confirmed risks involve Azure client secret handling, privileged Graph mutations, admin consent, bearer token forwarding, and broad delegated grants.

remediation.issue: Client secret examples use AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET and Graph addPassword flows.
remediation.suggestion: Keep client secret guidance clearly limited to local development and prefer Workload Identity Federation or managed identity for production.

remediation.issue: Permission grant examples include broad scopes, AllPrincipals consent, and long expiry.
remediation.suggestion: Add stronger least-privilege guidance, shorter grant lifetimes, and examples that scope grants per agent role.

remediation.issue: The AgentID sidecar exposes unauthenticated token helper endpoints when reachable.
remediation.suggestion: Require localhost or private pod-network binding, avoid public ingress, and document network policies for production deployments.

remediation.issue: Admin consent commands can approve tenant-wide permissions.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to review requested app roles and delegated scopes with a tenant administrator before running consent commands.

content.value_statement: Agent teams need distinct identities, grants, and audit trails for each AI agent instance. This skill guides Blueprint, Agent Identity, token exchange, and sidecar setup with Microsoft Graph.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to create Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities.
Provides Microsoft Graph request patterns for provisioning identities and assigning Graph permissions.
Guides OAuth 2.0 fmi_path token exchange for autonomous and on-behalf-of agent flows.
Documents Workload Identity Federation, client secret, and managed identity credential options.
Shows sidecar deployment patterns for Python, TypeScript, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes.
Lists common Agent ID errors and operational fixes for setup and token exchange issues.
limitations: It does not verify live Microsoft Graph API behavior without current documentation lookup.
It does not replace tenant administrator review for roles, consent, and permission grants.
It assumes the user has valid Entra roles and prepared app registrations or managed identities.
It provides examples, not a complete production identity governance program.

use_cases.title: Create Agent Identities
use_cases.description: Plan and provision a Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, and separate Agent Identity for each deployed agent instance.

use_cases.title: Configure Agent Token Exchange
use_cases.description: Build autonomous or on-behalf-of token flows that give each agent its own Graph token and audit trail.

use_cases.title: Deploy AgentID Sidecar
use_cases.description: Configure the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar for polyglot agents running in containers.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Blueprint Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a Microsoft Entra Agent ID Blueprint for one agent type. List prerequisites, roles, and the creation order.

prompt_templates.title: Create Agent Identities
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through creating a BlueprintPrincipal and three Agent Identities with least-privilege Microsoft Graph grants.

prompt_templates.title: Design Token Exchange
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an fmi_path token exchange flow for autonomous agents using Workload Identity Federation in Azure.

prompt_templates.title: Review Sidecar Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my AgentID sidecar deployment plan for Kubernetes. Focus on localhost binding, secrets, workload identity, and permission boundaries.

output_examples.input: I need an Agent ID setup for a support agent and a billing agent.
output_examples.output: A role and object plan that separates the two agents, creates one Blueprint, and grants only needed Graph permissions per identity.

output_examples.input: My OBO exchange fails with AADSTS50013.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting checklist that verifies the user token audience, Blueprint API scope, optional claims, and per-agent delegated grants.

output_examples.input: I want to run the AgentID sidecar in AKS.
output_examples.output: A deployment review covering workload identity, sidecar localhost binding, health probes, configuration separation, and public exposure risks.

best_practices: Verify current Microsoft Learn guidance before running Graph requests because Agent ID API shapes can change.
Use Workload Identity Federation or managed identity for production instead of client secrets.
Grant permissions per Agent Identity and review every admin consent action before execution.
anti_patterns: Do not expose the AgentID sidecar through a public LoadBalancer, Ingress, or shared network path.
Do not grant broad Graph scopes to every agent when each identity needs a narrower permission set.
Do not use Azure CLI tokens or DefaultAzureCredential for Agent ID APIs when the flow rejects those tokens.

faq.question: What is Microsoft Entra Agent ID?
faq.answer: It is an Entra identity model for AI agents, with separate identities and audit trails per agent instance.

faq.question: Does this skill create standard app registrations?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, Agent Identities, and related token exchange flows.

faq.question: Can I use this with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill content is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it support on-behalf-of authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains Blueprint API setup, delegated grants, and the OBO exchange path for user-delegated agent access.

faq.question: Should I use client secrets in production?
faq.answer: No. Use Workload Identity Federation or managed identity for production deployments whenever possible.

faq.question: Does the sidecar need public network access?
faq.answer: No. Keep the AgentID sidecar on localhost or the same private container network.
